title: A zero-length file read still returns zero after observed EOF
summary: A zero-length file read returned zero after EOF. An empty slice at the end of the destination still alternated correctly with positive reads and left every sentinel intact.

change.description: Honor a zero-length bulk read after a Jimfs stream has already recorded end of file.

notes: The endpoint is a valid empty slice. No call can create data in an empty file.
With identical compiled caller bytes, 1.3.1 matched the parent and 1.3.2 matched the landing on all three histories.
